input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products in production; merge when done.
errors: Made-up GlobalIds in samples/make-revision.mjs were first 23 and 21 characters; takeoff's isElement requires 22, so the elements vanished silently. Fixed; worth a warning in isElement rather than a silent skip.
First local workflow run failed check_smooth_scroll.py (unguarded scrollIntoView smooth); fixed with --fix, ventures-tests rerun 5/5.
run_workflow_locally.py rejects a workflow name together with --for-changes; the first rerun exited 0 having run nothing.
integrity_issues: Caught before merge: the first diff kept the last row per GlobalId, and got HHS construction2.ifc (a duplicate GlobalId) right only by file order. Now prefers the same class and a test orders them the other way.

doc_friction.issue: 'pass a workflow name or --for-changes, not both' exits 0, so a background run looks like a pass; it should exit nonzero.
isElement drops entities whose GlobalId is not 22 characters without a note; a hand-written sample lost two elements silently.

deviations.why: Left geom.mjs alone though a world box would sit naturally there, because PR #17830 (planar advanced breps) was working in it at the same time; computed the box in qto.mjs from the exported solidExtent.

notes: Flagship 14 item (5), the revision change report: diff.mjs, page section, cli --compare, hand-checked sample revision, eval on five real Revit exports of OpeningDesign's Aalseth Residence (190 of 1,011 GlobalId-only adds/removes were the same element) and three HHS Office controls (exact). node --test 42 pass; Chromium drive of the compare flow, no errors, no overflow at 390 px. run_workflow_locally: pages.yml 6/6 and portfolio-validate.yml 100/100 run steps passed (uses: steps not run); ventures-tests.yml 5/5 after the smooth-scroll fix. Seeded faults: five, each fails a test.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a senior JS developer with IFC experience: diff module, page, tests and an eval on real revisions, about two days

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
